title: MIND THE ACCENT GAP: BRITISH ACCENT ROBUSTNESS IN SPEECH-DRIVEN FINANCIAL VOICE ASSISTANTS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) Word Error Rate (WER) and downstream LLM tool-calling Exact Match (EM) across four British accent categories (Scottish, Southern English, Other British, Non-British) using a custom dataset of spoken financial queries (CavaBench) under various acoustic conditions.
